verdict.rationale: Buzz's own agent runtime, buzz-agent, is an MCP client by design: it runs LLM tool calls via MCP and feeds the results back. Buzz Persona Packs explicitly bundle MCP server config alongside personas and skills, so users can attach MCP servers to agents deployed in Buzz. missing for 10: detailed documentation of how users register or configure arbitrary third-party MCP servers (config format, transports, per-agent scoping), and independent or hands-on corroboration that plugged-in servers' tools work in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: The agent loops: call the LLM → get tool calls → run them via MCP → feed results back → repeat
A pack contains: personas (identity + system prompt), skills (on-demand instruction sets), MCP server config, pack-level instructions, lifecycle hooks, and distribution metadata
